command_line:
set -eu

cat > analysis.R << 'REOF'
# Read inputs from command line arguments
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
data_file <- args[1]
sample_file <- args[2]

# Read data matrix (samples x miRNAs)
cat("Reading data matrix...\n")
dm <- read.table(data_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1,
                 check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("NA","NAN","NaN",""))

cat(sprintf("Data matrix: %d samples x %d miRNAs\n", nrow(dm), ncol(dm)))

# Read sample metadata
cat("Reading sample metadata...\n")
sm <- read.table(sample_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1,
                 check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Sample metadata: %d samples\n", nrow(sm)))

# Ensure sample order matches
if (!all(rownames(dm) %in% rownames(sm))) {
  stop("Sample names in dataMatrix and sampleMetadata do not match")
}
sm <- sm[rownames(dm), , drop=FALSE]

group_col <- "Group"
if (!(group_col %in% colnames(sm))) {
  stop(sprintf("Group column not found in sample metadata. Columns: %s",
               paste(colnames(sm), collapse=", ")))
}

groups <- sm[[group_col]]
unique_groups <- unique(groups)
cat(sprintf("Groups: %s\n", paste(unique_groups, collapse=", ")))
cat(sprintf("Group counts: %s\n", paste(table(groups), collapse=", ")))

if (length(unique_groups) != 2) {
  stop(sprintf("Expected exactly 2 groups, found %d: %s",
               length(unique_groups), paste(unique_groups, collapse=", ")))
}

# Identify group indices
g1 <- unique_groups[1]
g2 <- unique_groups[2]
idx1 <- which(groups == g1)
idx2 <- which(groups == g2)

cat(sprintf("Group '%s': %d samples, Group '%s': %d samples\n",
            g1, length(idx1), g2, length(idx2)))

# Run t-test for each miRNA
n_mirnas <- ncol(dm)
p_values <- numeric(n_mirnas)
names(p_values) <- colnames(dm)

cat(sprintf("Running t-tests for %d miRNAs...\n", n_mirnas))

for (i in seq_len(n_mirnas)) {
  vals1 <- dm[idx1, i]
  vals2 <- dm[idx2, i]

  # Remove NA values
  vals1 <- vals1[!is.na(vals1)]
  vals2 <- vals2[!is.na(vals2)]

  # Need at least 2 values in each group for t-test
  if (length(vals1) < 2 || length(vals2) < 2) {
    p_values[i] <- NA
    next
  }

  # Check for zero variance
  if (var(vals1) == 0 && var(vals2) == 0) {
    p_values[i] <- NA
    next
  }

  # Welch two-sample t-test
  tt <- tryCatch(
    t.test(vals1, vals2, var.equal=FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(tt)) {
    p_values[i] <- tt$p.value
  } else {
    p_values[i] <- NA
  }
}

# Remove NA p-values
valid_idx <- !is.na(p_values)
p_valid <- p_values[valid_idx]
cat(sprintf("Valid tests: %d out of %d\n", sum(valid_idx), n_mirnas))

# Bonferroni correction
bonf_adj <- p.adjust(p_valid, method="bonferroni")
bonf_sig <- sum(bonf_adj <= 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Bonferroni significant (p<=0.05): %d\n", bonf_sig))

# Benjamini-Yekutieli correction
by_adj <- p.adjust(p_valid, method="BY")
by_sig <- sum(by_adj <= 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Benjamini-Yekutieli significant (p<=0.05): %d\n", by_sig))

# Compute ratio
if (by_sig > 0) {
  ratio <- bonf_sig / by_sig
} else {
  ratio <- NA
}
cat(sprintf("Ratio Bonferroni:BY = %d:%d = %f\n", bonf_sig, by_sig, ratio))

# Write results to output file
out_file <- "results.txt"
writeLines(c(
  sprintf("Total_miRNAs_tested: %d", n_mirnas),
  sprintf("Valid_tests: %d", sum(valid_idx)),
  sprintf("Bonferroni_significant: %d", bonf_sig),
  sprintf("Benjamini_Yekutieli_significant: %d", by_sig),
  sprintf("Ratio_Bonferroni_BY: %d:%d", bonf_sig, by_sig)
), out_file)

cat(sprintf("Results written to %s\n", out_file))
REOF
